messages.text:
The shop’s records show the cordless screwdriver was received back (refund-policy/v2/return). A refund can only go to the order’s original payment, not a new card; cancelling the old card doesn’t change that, and the card issuer handles any credit (refund-policy/v2/payment). The amount for the screwdriver is BRL 150.00 (refund-policy/v2/amount).

Would you like me to request the refund to the original payment?
